title: A calmer Amberfield
text:
Fewer, better-spread monsters around Amberfield and Mirrowmere, and new names that match their new looks.

⬆️ About a third fewer monsters around Amberfield and Mirrowmere, spread further apart, so new players aren't swarmed the moment they leave town
⬆️ Old Rendclaw (formerly Old Tusk) now prowls the open fields east of the lake instead of waiting at the town's east gate
⬆️ Grimmaw now lurks on the north shore of Mirrowmere, away from the southern cliffs, and the other lake monsters keep their distance from it
⬆️ The moths no longer gather by the east gate; they drift over the meadows south and west of the lake
✨ New names to match the new models: Spindlewing Moth, Old Rendclaw, Murkmaw Ghoul, Chainbound Drowned, Hollow Magus and Grimmaw the Bonecrawler
⬆️ Bram's quests are rewritten to match: Ghouls on the Shore, Drowned in Irons, The Hollow Magi and Grimmaw the Bonecrawler. Quests you already started carry on as before
